label: Federal rescheduling
note: Full rescheduling still awaits the DEA judge's recommended decision (final GAO-report briefs filed Nov 5; no timing given). DEA registered 900+ medical dispensaries in seven states on Oct 30 but has rejected registrants in CA, DE, DC, IL, MN, ND and OR. Medical operators have asked the D.C. Circuit to pause DEA's rules before the Nov 29 deadline to deal only with registered operators; DEA filed in opposition Nov 23
